name: gloomy_octopus_throw
description: Gloomy octopus mid-throw, facing right: body reared up, front arms gathered under it holding a tan bundle of silt and shells, the funnel-shaped siphon visible under the body with its mouth at local (+100,-120) pointing forward, and a short burst of tan silt, pebbles and shell bits leaving forward-right (sandy, not ink). Rear arms planted. Anchor bottom-centre, same footprint as gloomy_octopus; ~x -350..355, y -415..+20.
